summary: [¶] - b) The Petitioner filed Petition No. 80/TT/2016 seeking approval of Annual Fixed Charges (AFC) and the determination of transmission tariff for the licensed transmission business from COD to FY 2018-19 regarding the 400 kV Srinagar Substation, pursuant to the Commission’s order dated 31.1.2013 in Petition No. 133/MP/2012. [¶] - c) The Commission, through its order dated 9.11.2021 in Petition No. 80/TT/2016, determined the Annual Fixed Charges (AFC) from the COD to FY 2018-19 for the following transmission assets: [para 27] 27. Therefore, the time delay up to 19.2.2021 in the non-utilisation of 400 kV line bays associated with the 400 kV D/C Khandukhal (Srinagar) – Kashipur (Rampura) transmission line is attributable to the Petitioner and as such the Petitioner’s claim to allow their COD from 31.7.2016, as per proviso (ii) to Regulation 4 (3) of the 2014 Tariff Regulations, is hereby rejected. [para 33] 33. Therefore, in view of the above facts and in the absence of any agreed time schedule between the Petitioner and the execution agency of 400 kV D/C Khandukhal (Srinagar) - Kashipur (Rampura) Transmission Line under TBCB, we are of the view that the claim of the Petitioner for approval of COD under regulation 5(2) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations concerning 2 Nos. 400 kV line bays associated with the aforementioned transmission line at Srinagar Substation cannot be considered in the instant Petition. [para 34] 34. Accordingly, the Petitioner is hereby directed to file a separate Petition for the determination of tariff in respect of the aforementioned 2 Nos. 400 kV bays at the Srinagar Substation matching the SCOD/COD of the 400 kV D/C Khandukhal – Rampura transmission line implemented by M/s Megha Engineering & Infrastructure Limited under TBCB. Accordingly, their respective capital costs have been excluded from the capital cost for the purpose of working out the annual fixed charges. [para 36] 36. In view of the above discussions, we are not inclined to approve the COD of the said 2 Nos. line bays as the associated downstream transmission line under the scope of the Petitioner are yet to be commissioned. The Petitioner is also directed to approach the Commission for approval of COD and subsequent tariff after the start of utilisation of said 2 Nos. line bays through a separate tariff Petition, as per the relevant Tariff Regulations in future. Accordingly, their respective capital costs have been excluded from the capital cost for the purpose of working out the annual fixed charges. Accordingly, the Petitioner was directed to submit the charging certificates for the 400 kV and 220 kV bus couplers and bus transfer bays at Srinagar Substation. title: Approval under Sections 61, 62, 79(1)(c) and 79(1)(d) of the Electricity Act, 2003, Regulation 86 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999, read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014 and the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 for truing up of transmission tariff from COD to FY 2018-19 and determination of transmission tariff for the 2019-24 tariff period for 400 kV Substation Srinagar (Asset-I: 400/220 kV 02x03x105 ICT, 220/132 kV 02x160 MVA ICT along with bays and Asset-II: 1x80 MVAr Reactor) (Deemed ISTS) under UITP Scheme.
